Results.ReviewText:
I've owned several Weber grills and still do.  I recently had to retire my original Weber premium grill (3rd I've owned) as the ash cleaner/catcher assembly had finally given up and the great warranty Weber offers had long expired. They had replaced it once, but that was 4 years ago.

Lot's of great things about this grill and a couple of things that are workable.

Ash management:
I love the new and improved ash catcher.  The design prevents putting too much pressure on the aluminum support ring that "hung" from the bottom via tabs inserted above the legs.  The newer design makes it easy to pinch and remove for cleaning and super simple to line up and replace when done.  Just a slight tilt to slide it into the stop/pivot point and then level it out and latch it in.  Easy.  The previous design had a slot on each side that you had to bend down to visually line up and then even raise into the slots and twist to lock it in. 
 As the grill was used more and more, this mechanism would wear down.  The support ring or ash catcher bucket would become slightly out of round making it difficult to remove and replace.  The ash sweeper required some regular cleaning of the grill bowl to ensure build up wouldn't impede it's motion.  Easy enough with some warm water, simple green, a scrap piece of wood to chisel the carbon build up and some double out steel wool to shine it back up.  

The ride:
Love the new height and the smooth rolling wheels!  The material on the wheels is a bit softer than the old ones and rolls smoothly and quietly out of the garage to grill up some tasty food.

Lid:
Handle with a heat shield and heat protected vent tab are awesome.  The temp probe is a nice add too.  What I don't like often is that the lid holder limits access to the grill surface. Two cases where this is a pain:  1) Lighting charcoal requires that I move chimney as far to the side as I can opposite of the open lid or take the lid off to center the chimney.  2) Access to food can be a bit limited with the lid blocking the way.  Again, these are easy to work around.  Just worth mentioning.

Cooking grate:
Sounded cool to have a center section that could be swapped out with different options.  In reality, it's a pain in that when removing the grate to load the grill with coals, the center section will fall out if you aren't careful.  I can't hang my grate by the grill handle any longer as I start coals.  I'm just going to end up getting a new 22" grate without the center section thing.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText:
Really love this grill. So far everything I have cooked on it, even stuff I've never cooked before, has come out tasting great. At the end of the day that's all that matters, right? I'm an ex-gasser and learning to grill over charcoal has been fun, and the experience of charcoal grilling itself is just more fun to me. Takes a little longer to get going than a gas grill, but to me this it is well worth the additional 10 - 15 minute wait.

I will say that at first I had trouble distinguishing it from the Original Premium. I had previously budgeted to buy a more much expensive grill but ended up returning that, opting for something simpler. This was therefore well within my price range, so I just went for the most expensive of the three available kettles available at the store thinking I would do some research later and figure out exactly what I was paying for.

Unfortunately the retailer I purchased this from had all the grills up on a shelf, locked down, so I couldn't actually look at them side by side. But from what I've seen in videos, the Master-Touch stands a little taller and sturdier. Combine that with the tuck away lid holder, and I can imagine it is easily worth the price difference above the Original Premium. 

Now, the other features I am pretty so-so on. The included Char Baskets are nice, but there is little instruction on how you should use them. Also made me feel a little like I was supposed to use them rather than like they were an upgrade. Not sure I would purchase those if they were separately advertised to me. Same thing with the Warming Rack that is included, except I actually use the baskets. Most often it feels like the rack is just in the way, and I have to take it off, tuck it away while actually grilling, and then put it back on when done so I don't have stuff laying around everywhere. I may just not have found the right use for it yet.

The GBS, truthfully, is not something I'm too excited about. I went ahead and purchased the sear grate (have yet to use it) just because I could. But a lot of times the middle insert is just another thing I have to manage when getting the grill set up. Now I've heard the GBS stainless grate is sturdier and thicker, so perhaps this will be made up for over time, or maybe it provides an advantage I'm not aware of. But right now I'm not too keen on other GBS components. May just be more of a personal preference.

All that aside, when talking value of included upgrades and features, the Master-Touch is a fantastic deal. Add everything up over the price of the Original Premium and you definitely get your money's worth. Now if what you want is something barebones and basic, I would suggest the Original Premium, though to be fair I have not used that one. I LOVE my grill, and I would grill on it every night if I could. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking to get into charcoal grilling.

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber, always have and always will. That being said, this was such a disappointment in the assembly. It says 45 minutes, well it took me over 45 minutes just to get the legs in. They would not fit into the hole on the grill. I had to twist and turn and twist and turn and finally use a rubber mallet to gently tap them in. ALL THREE LEGS WERE LIKE THIS!!! After about an hour, I was finally on to step 2. Things went fairly smoothly after that until I got to the lid hanging attachment. I installed it and noticed one side wouldn't spin like it was supposed to. After further review, the hole that the screw goes in was drilled about 1/2" too high. Because of this, the knob of the spinner was directly on the lid instead of under the lip. Instead of drilling a new hole in my brand new grill, I spent the next 45 minutes trying to whittle the end of the knob off so it would fit under the lip of the grill like it was supposed to. After that was done, and the lid hanger worked like it was supposed to, I thought I was finally home free. All that was left was to install the thermometer...and that looked super easy. I put the thermometer face in the insert, put the probe through the top of the grill and grabbed the included wing nut to fasten it in place. I spun and spun that wing nut and just could not get it to catch the threads. After closely inspecting the nut, I realized they sent a nut WITHOUT ANY THREADS!!! So I had to drive across town to a local hardware store with my thermometer and find a nut that would fit. After all this, I finally got my grill together and the first coals burning in it a mere FOUR HOURS AFTER I OPENED THE BOX!!!   Good thing we had already made other plans for dinner that night!!

Results.ReviewText:
Après 25 ans de cuisson au propane, j'ai fait le saut à la cuisson au charbon de bois! C'est un changement stimulant et amusant! J'ai acheté ce modèle car je ne voulais pas investir un gros montant alors que je n'étais pas certain d'aimer ce type de cuisson. De plus je voulais un appareil assez léger pour le déplacer du patio supérieur au patio inférieur sans forcer et sans l'endommager.

Acheté il y a 6 semaines avec quelques accessoires (cheminée d'allumage, racloir à cendres, grille gourmet en fonte, plat rond en fonte, housse et assiettes d'aluminium).

Assemblage facile (environ 15 minutes). Allumage du charbon de bois très facile avec la cheminée d'allumage. Il suffit de déterminer quelle est la quantité optimale de morceaux de charbon, ce qui prend quelques essais. Cuisson directe et indirecte utiles. C'est facile de maintenir une température stable pendant >1 heure avec une seule charge de briquettes. Peu d'ajustements pour le maintien de la température mais avec l'usage des entrées d'air supérieure et inférieure, on y parvient assez bien. Thermomètre assez juste. Le livre "La Bible du Barbecue" de S.Raichlen m'a été d'une grande utilité et m'a permis de progresser en ne faisant pas de faux pas. 

Bref, j'utilise le Master Touch 22 po de Weber en complément de mon BBQ au propane. Je m'amuse à fond et j'ai toujours hâte au prochain repas!

RDes de Lévis, Québec

Results.ReviewText:
I have owned a basic Weber kettle grill for most of my adult life. I like the basic models because I hate paying for options I don't use or need. The only reason I had to replace grills was due to moving or my negligence; mainly dropping the lid (multiple times) which is why I had to buy a new grill. 

I skeptically decided to spend a little extra money Master Touch primarily for the lid holder. Spoiler alert, best decision on my part.
- The lid holder is a much better and secure design and already saved me a couple times.
- The lid handle has a heat shield which is very nice, for obvious reasons, and also helps with not dropping the lid.
- The removable center grill is a nice option that I never thought I'd use, but I was wrong. It's fantastic for maintaining heat for indirect grilling and I use their Gourmet BBQ gridle insert for "grilled" vegetables with the smoke flavor. 
- The temp gauge is another feature I never thought I use but is now the key when slow cooking to maintaining that perfect temp. 
- The ash catcher attachment is better and easier to use than my previous models, but I'm not sure if this design is now incorporated on all Webber kettle grills with ash catchers. Either way, it's much easier to use compared to the insert and turn method. 
- Assembly is typical and not too hard when you follow the instructions. I however used my two steps forward, one step back and then read the instructions method which still only took 20 minutes.

Bottom line, the Master touch is well worth the money.

Results.ReviewText: I was very excited when I made my purchase. When I used it for the first time to cook ribs nd chicken on it it work and cooked amazing easy to maintain heat. It was very easy to assemble.
Results.Title: bbq king

Results.ReviewText: I received this grill for Fathers day and had read multiple reviews and videos about it. Not only does it hold temp great for general grilling but also for a long smoke. It has been nothing but perfect. Only suggestion would be to use good lump charcoal to keep from having to add more for a long smoke.
Results.Title: Amazing Grill !

Results.ReviewText: Best charcoal grill ever. I’ve had Weber Charcoal Grills for many years. I grill for 60 to 70 people every week. The consistency in temperature on the Weber Charcoal Grill is amazing.
Results.Title: Can’t beat the Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Legs can be a little stronger. And the packaging was terrible. The 3 bottom drop out where the legs go we’re chipped up pretty badly. Highly doubt I’d order another grill..
Results.Title: Chipped

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a month ago and am perfecting the BBQing. It’s been awesome, easy to use and we’ve made some amazing foods.  Just so happy we bought a Weber.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: I actually collect Weber grills and when the new colors were made available I was really excited. I love and will have the smoke and ivory eventually. Was showing my girlfriend the new colors and she said how much she like that spring green and if she had one she would cook on it when I was working late. So, I ordered not the smoke and not the ivory, but the spring green for her!!! She loves it and is cooking on it all the time. Hopefully I will be ordering a smoke and ivory for me!!! Thanks Weber, you guys are great!!!
Results.Title: Review of new spring green

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber grill over many years. I really like the grill overall, but the great has a removable center piece that come out when You are cleaning it and also gets food and grease stuck in-between the two greats.
Results.Title: Hate the grate

Photos.Caption: 2 gros rack de ribs pas le temp de niezer

Results.ReviewText: Le meilleur outil de cuisson que j'ai et je l'adore
Results.Title: Multi fonctionnelle

Results.ReviewText: Been wanting an Ivory for quite awhile.  Never pulled the trigger on a Canadian, or Euro version.  Glad that I procrastinated long enough for Weber to offer more color options in the US.  In all honesty, as much as I like all the MT colors, I bought the Ivory mainly to have a patriotic patio.  Weber quality & design is still tops.  I really like addition of the “P” shaped bowl dampers.  My only complaint is about the aesthetics of the wheels.  The gray hubcaps have always seemed like an afterthought to me.  So, I decided to go the custom route, and ordered some Gen.2 Performer wheels when I ordered it.  I now have “my perfect Ivory”.
Results.Title: Thanks Weber...for giving US more color!!!

Results.ReviewText: A friend gave me this grill and I have been totally impressed. I was use to grilling with my very old grill and was unsure if I could master the new style. It’s a Cadillac and very easy! I just have to stay close due to decrease in cooking time.
Results.Title: Great Cooking Experience

Results.ReviewText: Combination Father's Day and Birthday gift for Hubby: A really big hit!  I saw him eying it online and surprised him. Sooo many great features on this one, and Weber is THE BEST, bar none.
Results.Title: Upgrade Hubby's grill

Results.ReviewText: I got this for my husband for father's day. We absolutely love it. When we first used it the bottom of the grill turned brown once it got hot, but once the grill cooled off it went back to green. I highly recommend this grill!
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: Je l'utilise depuis un mois et j'en suis tres satisfait
Results.Title: Simple d'utilisation

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
